skill.name: extend-signal-schema
skill.description: Extend AFI signal schemas and validators safely while preserving deterministic behavior, PoI boundaries, tests, and governance requirements.
skill.summary: Guides safe AFI signal schema updates with validators, tests, and migration notes.
skill.author: AFI-Protocol

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious execution intent was found in SKILL.md. The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, file paths, examples, governance references, and conventional build or test guidance. The skill is documentation for controlled AFI schema edits.

static_findings.snippet: This skill is primarily used by `schema-validator-droid` and any future afi-core
- `schemas/universal_signal_schema.ts` — Main signal schema (may cover all stages)
- Do NOT add `poi`, `poinsight`, `proof_of_intelligence`, or similar fields.
At the end of a successful `extend-signal-schema` operation, produce a short
- "Add an optional `macro_regime` field to Enriched signals with enum values
- "Extend the Scored schema to include a `risk_breakdown` object with sub-scores
- "Add a `derivative_underlier` string field to Analyzed signals for
- "Add a required `content` field to all signals (already exists, but make it
- "Refine the `action` field to include new enum values: `buy`, `sell`, `hold`,
- **Option 2**: Add with `.default(value)` to provide backwards compatibility
**Request**: "Add an optional `macro_regime` field to Enriched signals."
and obeying the AFI Droid Charter and AFI Core AGENTS.md boundaries.
- **Governed**: Aligned with AFI Droid Charter, AFI Droid Playbook, and afi-core/AGENTS.md
- Avoid random values, timestamps, or external API calls

content.value_statement: Signal schema changes can break validators and downstream pipelines. This skill guides safe AFI schema updates with validation, tests, and migration notes.
actual_capabilities: Identifies AFI signal lifecycle stages and related schema files.
Guides Zod field additions, defaults, enums, and validation rules.
Keeps PoI and PoInsight as validator-level concepts.
Updates related type exports and validators when needed.
Requires focused tests and build validation for schema changes.
Summarizes changed stages, fields, files, tests, and compatibility notes.
limitations: Requires access to the afi-core repository and its governance documents.
Does not modify tokenomics, infrastructure, gateways, or orchestration systems.
Requires human approval for breaking schema changes or unclear governance issues.
Does not guarantee migrations for existing production data.

use_cases.title: Add Optional Signal Fields
use_cases.description: Add optional lifecycle fields while keeping existing signals compatible and documented.

use_cases.title: Refine Validator Rules
use_cases.description: Tighten Zod validation rules and related TypeScript exports without broad refactors.

use_cases.title: Review Breaking Changes
use_cases.description: Assess required fields, defaults, tests, and migration notes before approving schema changes.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Field Addition
prompt_templates.scenario: A user knows the stage and field name.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add an optional macro regime field to Enriched signals. Explain the needed schema, test, and compatibility updates.

prompt_templates.title: Validator Refinement
prompt_templates.prompt: Refine the action field validation for Scored signals. Preserve compatibility and list tests that should change.

prompt_templates.title: Migration Planning
prompt_templates.scenario: A required field may affect existing data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a safe migration for making the content field required across all signal stages. Include defaults and review questions.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-File Schema Review
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a complete change plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review a proposed risk breakdown field for Scored signals. Identify schema files, validators, exports, tests, and governance boundaries.

output_examples.input: Add an optional market regime field to Enriched signals.
output: The response identifies Enriched as the target stage.
It recommends an optional enum field with clear documentation.
It lists schema, export, and test files that need review.
It notes that optional fields are backward compatible.

output_examples.input: Make content required for every signal.
output: The response marks the request as potentially breaking.
It suggests a default or staged migration before enforcement.
It calls for validator and test updates.
It asks for human approval if compatibility is unclear.

best_practices: Start with the lifecycle stage, field type, optionality, and compatibility impact.
Keep schema edits narrow and update validators only when validation logic is required.
Record build results, test results, migration notes, and open questions in the final summary.
anti_patterns: Do not add PoI or PoInsight as signal fields.
Do not combine schema changes with orchestration, tokenomics, gateway, or infrastructure edits.
Do not remove or rename existing fields without an explicit migration strategy.

faq.question: What repositories does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets afi-core signal schemas, related validators, exports, and focused tests.

faq.question: Can it change orchestration pipelines?
faq.answer: No. Orchestration changes belong outside this skill and should be escalated.

faq.question: Can it add PoI or PoInsight fields?
faq.answer: No. The skill treats PoI and PoInsight as validator-level traits only.

faq.question: How does it handle optional fields?
faq.answer: It prefers optional fields when possible because they preserve backward compatibility.

faq.question: How does it handle required fields?
faq.answer: It recommends defaults, staged migration, or explicit human approval before enforcement.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for repository editing.
